title: Choo-choo train, Skippy Core's chat model, MineBench's own procedure
model: Skippy Core's chat model (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, UD-Q4_K_XL, thinking off), run exactly as MineBench runs a model: its full tool-mode prompt and its repair loop (up to 8 attempts)
verdict: Built on the second of MineBench's attempts (the first reply had no JSON in it), 6 minutes in all. A train you can name: a black locomotive with a stack, then red, blue and green cars, and a 256-block track with ballast and verges. But the train stands across the end of the track instead of on it: the track runs one way and the whole train the other, the lost sense of forward the older runs had. No station or scenery beyond the track bed; 33 small pieces float.
